style: 32mm tabletop miniature concept art, gothic horror fantasy (Curse of Strahd). Full body, front three-quarter view, standing with both feet planted on flat ground, props held close to the body, no base, no scenery, plain white background, even lighting, painted-miniature look, muted colors with oxblood accents.

base.note: D&D Small and Medium creatures both use a 25 mm base, so every PC shares the same base.

characters.name: Mathias Kell
characters.look: A broad-shouldered human man in his late thirties with a weathered, scarred face, short dark hair greying at the temples and a close-cropped beard. He wears a battered chain mail hauberk over a faded oxblood surcoat with a torn hem, a heavy leather belt with pouches, and a quiver of javelins across his back. He holds a greatsword point-down in front of him, both hands resting on the crossguard. A small cold-silver dragon scale hangs on a chain at his chest.

characters.name: Isolde Marrec
characters.look: A tall human woman in her early thirties with pale skin, severe aristocratic features and dark auburn hair in one tight braid. She wears chain mail under a stained white tabard with a faded gold sunburst, and a short half-cape. A heater shield is strapped to her left arm and she holds a longsword low in her right hand. A single white feather with gilded edges is tied into her braid.

characters.name: Agna Brightvein
characters.look: A stout dwarf woman with a ruddy, kind, weathered face and thick copper-red hair braided and coiled around her head. She wears a chain shirt under a cream and ochre priest's robe, carries a round wooden shield painted with a rising sun on her left arm and a flanged mace in her right hand. A bronze rising-sun medallion hangs on her chest and a small iron lantern hangs from her belt. Her boots stand directly on the white background with no base, plinth or ground disc beneath her.

characters.name: Varis
characters.look: A lean, androgynous wood elf with bark-brown skin, pointed ears and long moss-green and grey hair threaded with twigs and wooden beads. They wear a hooded mantle of patched moss-green cloth and leaves over simple leather armor, with cloth-wrapped feet. They grip a gnarled quarterstaff taller than themselves, a wooden shield is slung on their back, a carved stone disc hangs at their throat and a bird skull wrapped in red thread dangles from their belt.

characters.name: Ambrose Tinwick
characters.look: A small, fussy gnome man with a large nose, round brass spectacles, wild white hair and tufted eyebrows. He wears layered dusty-blue scholar's robes spattered with ink and a satchel stuffed with scrolls. He clutches a thick leather spellbook under one arm and holds a pointed quartz crystal up in the other hand. A sliver of amber hangs on a cord around his neck and a pocket watch chain loops from his robe.

characters.name: Sorrow
characters.look: A slender tiefling woman with deep violet skin, curling ram horns, long black hair, solid gold eyes and a thin tail. She wears a fortune-teller's layered plum and black skirts, a fringed shawl hung with small coins and a fitted leather bodice. She holds a faintly glowing crystal ball up in one hand and a fan of tarot cards in the other, with a crumpled page of runes tucked into her sash.

characters.name: Fennick Crowe
characters.look: A small, wiry halfling man with a sly grin, curly chestnut hair and long sideburns, barefoot with large hairy feet. He wears a dark grey hooded cloak thrown back over fitted black leather armor covered in straps and pouches. He holds a shortsword low in his right hand and a dagger in his left, with a shortbow and quiver on his back.

characters.name: Luca Moravek
characters.look: A lanky young human man with a charming smile, long wavy dark hair and a thin moustache. He wears a patched, colorful traveling performer's coat over leather armor, with a long, bright, much-mended striped scarf wrapped around his neck. He plays a violin tucked under his chin with the bow in his right hand, and a lute is slung across his back.

characters.name: Elowen Ashgrave
characters.summary: High Elf Ranger (Guide), the Exile's Daughter
characters.look: A tall, lithe elf woman with pale skin, a stern face, pointed ears and long silver-white hair in a side braid. She wears a hooded dark forest-green cloak over studded leather armor. She holds a longbow in her left hand with an arrow nocked and pointed at the ground, a scimitar hangs at her hip, the hilt of a broken elven blade is tucked into her belt and two quivers ride on her back.

characters.name: Volen Graymane
characters.look: A heavily muscled orc woman with grey-green skin, small tusks, a shaggy grey mane of hair and a ragged bite scar on her forearm. She wears a grey wolf-pelt mantle over bare shoulders, a rough homespun tunic and trousers, leather bracers and boots, and no armor. She holds a large greataxe diagonally across her body with both hands, a long wolf's fang hangs on a cord at her neck and two handaxes hang from her belt.
